summary: Prenetics Global Limited filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that CFO Stephen Hoi Chun Lo tendered resignation on October 30, 2026, effective December 30, 2026, to pursue new opportunities; he remains CFO through that date and will stay on in an advisory capacity after departing. The company will appoint Brian Rosin, currently CFO of subsidiary IM8 (US) LLC, as principal financial and accounting officer effective December 31, 2026, subject to board approval and an appointment agreement. No financial terms, advisors or regulatory clocks were disclosed. The transition appears orderly and pre-announced, not abrupt; watch for board ratification, any 20-F disclosure gaps, and whether the interim advisory role masks deeper finance-function turnover.
